workReports.financeReportsDesc: Work revenue, expense, collection, and reconciliation ledger
workReports.regReportsDesc: Attendee profile, occupancy, and quota analytics

financeView.scopeNotice: Operational Finance Area: Orders, payments, refunds, and extra services are managed here. For the general ledger and reconciliation, switch to Accounting.
financeView.sodNotice: Segregation of Duties (SoD): Manual collections of 50,000 TL and above require secondary manager approval.

accountingView.scopeNotice: General Ledger & Accounting Area: Incomes, expenses, general ledger, budget vs actual breakdown, and reconciliation are managed here. For order lines, return to Finance.
accountingView.workSettlementDesc: Financial audit and archival readiness for completed works
